names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 5 ianuarie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 5 Ιανουαρίου, «Άγιοι Θεόπεμπτος και Θεωνάς», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 5 января ст. ст., which gives the calendar's own nominative «Феона (в крещении Синесий) Никомидийский, мч.»; the rank word is left off, and the parenthesis is the calendar saying what he was named at his baptism rather than a second part of the form, so it is recorded in this note and not in the name. The line on the day page itself gives «Феоны волхва», Theonas the sorcerer.
The heading names two men; this is his own name, read out of it, with the rank word «Свештеномученик» left off.

death.note: doxologia.ro gives no year, only the reign: «Împăratul Dioclețian (284-305), în anul întâi al prigonirii ce s-a făcut de dânsul asupra creștinilor». The interval is that reign.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 5 января ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Феопемпта, еп. Никомидийского и мч. Феоны волхва (303)»

attestations.note: The same sorcerer who was baptised Synesius whom the folder's Greek row keeps on 5 January: the name link reads «Феона (в крещении Синесий) Никомидийский, мч.» — Theonas, at baptism Synesius — and the one life page the calendar gives for the pair, days.pravoslavie.ru/Life/life155.htm, tells how the bishop gave him that name. The day page carries no hymn under his name.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 5 ianuarie — «Sfântul Mucenic Teonas»
Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 5 Ιανουαρίου — «Άγιοι Θεόπεμπτος και Θεωνάς»
Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 18.01.2026 (5. јануар ст. ст.) — „Свештеномученик Теопемт и Теона.“
